This image features a pair of sleek, black open-back slippers with a minimalist design. They appear to have a cushioned and contoured base for comfort and ergonomic foot support. The slippers have a simple, matte finish, and are marked with the text "FZT" on the front toe area, likely indicating a brand name. A subtle blue arc design is visible near the top of the slippers, adding a modern and stylish touch.

The background is plain and light gray, providing a clean, professional aesthetic that highlights the product. Above the slippers is bold black Japanese text, which translates to phrases like "No smell, no noise," emphasizing the slippers' qualities. Below the main text, smaller Japanese text followed by English reads “Japan’s EVA slipper,” suggesting that the slippers are made from EVA (ethylene-vinyl acetate)—a lightweight and comfortable material. The design conveys a focus on functionality, durability, and style.

groups.title: Shift + 左键 添加正面（绿色）的坐标点。
Shift + 右键 添加负面（红色）的坐标点。
Ctrl + 左键 绘制方框。
右键坐标点 删除该点，不能删除点数组的起点/终点。
要添加图像，选择节点并粘贴或拖入图像。
此为手动调整遮罩，需要先点一下运行，等这个节点获取到第一帧图片后，点击取消运行程序。此时可以设置绿色的坐标点，用来指定需要替换部位的遮罩。（此程序只需设置绿色的点）
点击此节点最下面的New canvas  重置所有点
